summary: Let the first scaffold adoption take over replaced managed targets by base digest (#631)

delivery.outcome: An initial scaffold adoption can take over pre-existing targets replaced by the managed payload by exact base digest, so migrating a repository with agent host files fits the delivery budget without weakening it.
nonGoals: No budget increase or bypass for undeclared replacements.
No restorations or target-owned transitions in an initial adoption.
No change to upgrade (fromRevision set) takeover semantics.

architecture.decision: Reuse the existing managedTargetTakeovers binding for fromRevision null: verify_managed_base consumes a takeover only on an exact base digest match after the head managed digest is verified; standard_adoption_error still refuses restorations and transitions without a base lock. Source and bundled checker stay byte-identical and ship in one immutable release.
interfaceChanges: scripts/governance_check.py: standard_adoption_error and verify_managed_base accept initial managedTargetTakeovers
architecture.rollback: Revert to accepted base 643421776d57769a8f0158f649e354cd0d48e745; the previous immutable release remains available.

validation.evidence: An initial adoption that takes over the replaced AGENTS.md by base digest passes with a 1-file budget; a mismatched digest fails GOV-SYNC-001; the existing undeclared and hidden-target fixtures still fail.
standard_adoption_error accepts initial takeovers and still refuses initial restorations.
